messages:
leo: Heads-up 1 - NovaHealth pilot kickoff tomorrow. Need a slim preflight + clear SLA draft before onboarding.

meera: Agreed. I can finalize the preflight output. Suggested minimal JSON: status, failing_checks[], summary.

oliver: paste example?

meera: ```
{
  "status": "PASS",
  "failing_checks": [],
  "summary": "outbound OK, DNS OK, KMS OK (via proxy)"
}
```

frank: On networking: Nova insists on no inbound. Make sure agent supports websocket-only. Also ask SE for their proxy / egress ACL list.

leo: rollout stance: pilot tenants = manual fallback only. No auto-edge until we finish CAT run.

telemetry-bot: telemetry-bot: add request telem#450 for per-tenant heartbeat and upgrade-downtime metric.

oliver: upgrade plan: side-by-side agent reduces downtime risk. Prototype done; will add token-lease to avoid duplicates.

contracts: SLA sliding scale looks good. We'll require explicit exclusion clause: customer-managed-network outages excluded.

meera: action items: meera -> ship preflight + human summary (due 1775630000); oliver -> token-lease + side-by-side demo (due 1775700000); frank -> collect Nova egress ACLs + run pre-kickoff (due 1775680000); contracts -> finalize pilot SLA wording (due 1775740000).

leo: one-liner for public docs: always use "customer-managed networking" and list opt-in managed-edge fallback. Keep marketing copy conservative.

telemetry-bot: telemetry-bot: reminder meeting private-deploy-nova-kickoff scheduled at 1775560000.
